overall_status: Measured source-reported pressure-metrology capability retained; independent replay, further-device transfer, priority, and general breakthrough remain unestablished.

leads.statement: Yang, Stone, and Egan report a 5.7 ppm standard-uncertainty helium optical-pressure realization using synchronous same-fill dual-colour refractometry to estimate pressure while absorbing common cavity-length change as a nuisance.
leads.status: source-reported peer-reviewed experiment; primary article and supplement read; raw source archive timed out; no independent replay or external replication
main_assumptions: Same pressure/temperature/fill and a shared geometric length term across colours.
Known helium dispersion and thermodynamic temperature.
Coarse pressure estimate accurate enough to choose the integer mode branch, about 3.2 kPa.
Chromatic response modeled or bounded below the allocated uncertainty.
costs: 15 cm dual-band Fabry-Perot cavity and two frequency-referenced synchronous channels.
Pure helium, pressure and temperature standards, thermal settling around 650 s per 0.1 MPa step.
Theoretical helium dispersion contributes about 4 ppm to the reported 5.7 ppm combined uncertainty.
leads.falsifier_or_next_gate: A third colour under pressure, temperature, and fill-history perturbations yields a covariance-normalized common-mode residual above a preregistered threshold; otherwise the tested interface survives only for the measured perturbation class.
leads.novelty_boundary: Optical pressure and shared-nuisance algebra have prior art; bounded increment is the measured same-fill synchronous two-frequency dispersion implementation, not priority-cleared.

leads.statement: A July 2026 primary preprint reports direct microsecond-pulsed differential heat-capacity measurements of encapsulated CrSBr from monolayer to bulk-like thickness under magnetic field, with layer- and field-dependent anomalies and a background-dependent entropy analysis.
leads.status: source-reported preprint; methods and interface reconstructed; repository anti-bot blocked raw-data replay; not peer-reviewed validation or priority clearance
main_assumptions: Quasi-adiabatic 50 microsecond pulses and calibrated Pt resistance thermometry.
Matched differential cell remains stable over a measurement series.
Layer assignment, flake area, hBN addenda, and chosen lattice background are adequate for the stated entropy interpretation.
costs: Differential suspended SiN/Pt devices, 12-17 mA pulses, 100 ms relaxation, high vacuum, hBN encapsulation, and layer/area characterization.
The source does not state full curve duration or per-device raw noise.
leads.falsifier_or_next_gate: Replay deposited raw curves; test field-paired total specimen entropy with H-H0-H ordering and empty-cell/hBN controls. A spin-only interpretation additionally needs validated spin-lattice separation because precursor spin-phonon coupling is reported in bulk CrSBr.
leads.novelty_boundary: Prior bulk calorimetry and layer-sensitive optical/magnetic probes exist; bounded increment is direct pulsed Cp measurements down to monolayer in this material, not a general nanocalorimetry invention.

leads.statement: The SThM rational calibration response admits the classical local three-support D/G design after a saturation-coordinate transform; the source-parameter fixture reduces leverage and improves nominal information determinant relative to six log-spaced standards under ideal assumptions.
leads.status: conditional classical design consequence; finite fixture passed; practical calibration gain and novelty UNKNOWN
costs: Requires exact standard values, equal independent noise, stable probe tip, and appropriate roughness; high-k saturation remains.
leads.falsifier_or_next_gate: At equal image count, a preregistered matched calibration panel must improve held-out response prediction or blinded-sample conductivity coverage with actual certificate covariance and drift included.
